title: Why Are We Always Seeking Something More? (1981-09-20)
description:
Struggling with endless thoughts or emotional burnout? Discover the spiritual roots of mental exhaustion and how to finally find inner balance.

This public program explores human evolution and the spontaneous nature of Kundalini awakening. Shri Mataji explains how extremes in emotion or rationality lead to psychosomatic diseases, offering practical insights to balance our subtle system. Includes an illuminating Q&A with genuine seekers.

Key Topics:
• 🌟 The evolutionary leap: Why modern human beings are born as seekers searching for deeper spiritual meaning beyond material wealth
• ⚡ Spontaneous awakening: Why Kundalini is a living process that cannot be forced through physical efforts, mental projections or blind faith
• 🌙 The left side (Ida Nadi): How dwelling in the past and over-emotionality connects to the subconscious and can cause physical lethargy
• ☀️ The right side (Pingala Nadi): The spiritual danger of extreme rationality, over-planning, and how it exhausts the brain and your liver
• 💬 Q&A insights on genuine spirituality: Navigating previous meditation experiences, chakra placements on hands, and true inner healing

“If it’s a living process, evolution, if it’s a living God then the happening has to be living which you cannot achieve through your mental projections, neither through your efforts.”
— Shri Mataji Nirmala Devi

Audience Questions:
• Do we need to have any previous experiences in this type of yoga?
• I was curious about the fingers, does that correspond to the chakras?
• You talked about this sacrum bone center, can an injury be put right?
• Would you know when Christ is going to come down?

Common Questions About Spiritual Awakening:
• What causes psychosomatic diseases from a spiritual perspective?
• How to stop overthinking and calm the mind naturally?
• What happens to your brain during kundalini awakening?

Have you ever felt exhausted by overthinking or emotionally drained? Which side of your energy do you feel needs the most balancing right now?
